lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters positioned in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, exhibiting a decrease in spatial density as they progress toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with spots serving as the primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and a shadow vector on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs, primarily localized toward the anterior leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a high spatial frequency of small, irregular high-luminance clusters, creating a significantly denser and more chaotic pattern than the organized rows observed on the lateral flank.
